headline: A 2017 executive order setting rules meant to keep foreign terrorists from entering the United States.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how the federal government screens and allows people from other countries to enter the United States, with the stated goal of stopping foreign terrorists. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, countries, or programs it covers cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: People from other countries seeking to enter the United States
who_it_affects.how: They may face new or stricter screening or limits on entry under the order.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle visas, immigration, and border entry
who_it_affects.how: They would be directed to carry out the order's entry and screening rules.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 27, 2017; the provided material does not state a separate effective date.
